resources.string: Connect a cloud folder to safely and securely back up all your JSON data automatically.
Enable background syncing to effortlessly push all your image attachments to your connected cloud folder.
Tapping anywhere on a record during selection mode now intuitively selects it instead of opening the edit form.
Record timestamps now display the exact seconds, allowing for more precise tracking of your entries.
Added attention-mode warnings when disconnecting from the cloud to prevent accidental loss of sync settings.
